topic: Workout series: 6 dumbbell moves for arms

slides.label: HOW TO DO IT
slides.headline: Biceps + *forearms:*
items: Palms up, elbows pinned, no swing.
Thumbs up, curl to shoulder slowly.

slides.label: HOW TO DO IT
slides.headline: Triceps + *wrists:*
items: Elbows point up, lower behind head.
Hinge, upper arm still, press back.

focus: Add 1 rep or a little weight weekly
slides.truth: Arms grow from controlled reps and slowly lifting more over time.

slides.headline: Train *smarter*, not just harder.
slides.send: Send this to your gym buddy who skips arm day
